availability: known_as_of=last_day(origin); all contributing available_at<=known_as_of; partial months excluded

binding.target_access: Byte-level SHA only in prepare; target parquet is never queried or parsed

deficit_frequency: Mean robust past states only when every state known: round bounds to cents half-away-from-zero; upper<0 true, lower>=0 false, otherwise unknown; require base/trimmed agreement

definitions.deficit_frequency_3m: deficit_frequency: last 3 contiguous calendar months including current; population std; OLS slope per month
definitions.deficit_frequency_6m: deficit_frequency: last 6 contiguous calendar months including current; population std; OLS slope per month
definitions.log_gross_delta_prior_3m: current minus mean of prior 3 calendar months (current excluded)
definitions.log_gross_delta_prior_6m: current minus mean of prior 6 calendar months (current excluded)
definitions.log_gross_mean_3m: log_gross_mean: last 3 contiguous calendar months including current; population std; OLS slope per month
definitions.log_gross_mean_6m: log_gross_mean: last 6 contiguous calendar months including current; population std; OLS slope per month
definitions.log_gross_std_3m: log_gross_std: last 3 contiguous calendar months including current; population std; OLS slope per month
definitions.log_gross_std_6m: log_gross_std: last 6 contiguous calendar months including current; population std; OLS slope per month
definitions.net_ratio_delta_prior_3m: current minus mean of prior 3 calendar months (current excluded)
definitions.net_ratio_delta_prior_6m: current minus mean of prior 6 calendar months (current excluded)

definitions.net_ratio_mean_6m: net_ratio_mean: last 6 contiguous calendar months including current; population std; OLS slope per month
definitions.net_ratio_slope_3m: net_ratio_slope: last 3 contiguous calendar months including current; population std; OLS slope per month

eligibility: Current and prior 2 calendar months active, n_sin_eur=0, gross>0; es_calentamiento=false and first past observed activity at least 3 months before origin
gross: volumen_caja_conocido_eur; positive, complete known EUR only
label_independence: Prospective eligibility never requires future activity, target availability or non-null label
preprocessing: No fitted transforms in T2; imputation/scaling/selection train-only per fold in T3; preserve feature order
quality: coverage and missing_reason are metadata, not predictors or fixed health penalties
retrospective_limitation: Approved synthetic final snapshot; no import/category revision history. Not certified historical known_on.
window_missingness: Any absent/inactive/unknown-FX/nonpositive-gross month invalidates that window; never compress rows or fill zero; 6m completeness does not control eligibility
